cases.name: a2_delegated_approval_completed
cases.manifest: the same tree as case (a), whole: several approved tool calls in the child (each a new step id with the same idempotency key, rule 3), `$slim` pointers on waiting and completed records, status sub-runs with timer waits, the final answer.

cases.name: a_delegated_child_approval
cases.manifest: 2026-09-29 incident: the root (basic-agent@0.0.5) parks on a `subworkflow:<child>` delegation wait, the child waits on `tool_approval` and its waiting record's `effect.payload.tool_calls` is a `$slim` pointer to the STARTED record. The interaction is the child's approval with tool_calls resolved; the delegation is not one.

cases.name: b_timer_without_resume
cases.manifest: 2026-10-04 use case: a `wait_until` timer whose ledger has no resume record, followed by a later step of the same run: the wait is over (ended_by later_step) and the status is not waiting, even with a stale snapshot that still says waiting.

cases.name: c_parallel_tool_batch
cases.manifest: one tool_calls step with more than one call: every call is a row, each matched to its own result.

cases.name: d_cancellation
cases.manifest: a turn cancelled while its agent sub-run was working: the root and the agent run read cancelled, no open wait or interaction remains.

cases.name: e2_structured_repeated_node
cases.manifest: framework backlog 0993 'Case 2' (flow `assist`): the SAME Agent node (node-8) executed twice in a row; each execution is one activity and the two are never merged.

cases.name: e_structured_output_agents
cases.manifest: 1016 / executionIdFor: an Agent node execution is start_subworkflow started+waiting, a resume, and the `_temp.agent.<node>.structured` llm_call; the view shows ONE activity per execution (three Agent nodes, the last one cancelled while delegated).

cases.name: f_windowed_slim
cases.manifest: a windowed history: records start at seq > 1 and the child's approval wait carries a `$slim` pointer to a STARTED record outside the window: warnings name both, no `$slim` reaches the view, and the approval still lists its tool calls (from the wait's details).

cases.name: g_ask_user
cases.manifest: an ask_user question and its answer: a question message, an answer message (role user), the wait ended by the resume, no open interaction afterwards.

cases.name: h_denied_approval
cases.manifest: a denied tool approval as the runtime records it (no `approved:false` in the ledger: the approval step's results carry success false + the runtime's 'Denied by user'): the tool row and the activity read denied.

cases.name: i_wait_kinds
cases.manifest: wait kinds agree with the runtime's attention classifier: a USER pause is `pause`, an automation controller wake is `automation_wake`, an EVENT wait without prompt/choices is `signal` (none of them person-facing); an EVENT wait WITH a prompt is `event`, person-facing, and is the interaction (answer_payload `{payload}`).

cases.name: j_event_answered_then_pause
cases.manifest: an event question (EVENT wait with a prompt) answered by its resume, then a pause: the question is closed by the resume, the pause is an open wait but never an interaction, the run reads waiting.

cases.name: k_nested_delegation
cases.manifest: a two-level tree whose grandchild is discovered after its uncle: run rows are in tree order (root, A, G, B) in the view AND after folding deltas with apply_delta (a row's `order` sorts in tree order).

cases.name: l_answer_then_completion
cases.manifest: a run whose final output repeats the answer it already gave (answer_user) is ONE assistant message (marked final), whatever the read order (the snapshot read before or after the ledger).

cases.name: m_session_tool_policy
cases.manifest: a decision written twice (crash replay, same idempotency key) is one activity; a deny set after an approval gate was shown and answered approved wins (the tool row and the batch read denied, wait.outcome denied, denied_by session_policy); a session tool policy decides tool calls with NO wait (contract v1 section 5): each `abstract.tool_policy_decision` record is an activity (kind tool_policy, auto_approved / denied, policy revision and who set it), the tool rows it names say decided_by session_policy, the denied call is `denied` (not failed), and the view never shows an interaction.
